occurrences.text: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
